Beech Road Primary summer fair, Chorlton. Saturday 14 June 2025, 11:00 to 15:00. Our pitch was C4 next to the plant stall. Organiser: Mrs Adebayo (PTA), 07700 914 362. All profit to the school's new outdoor kitchen.

## Prep checklist

- [x] 14 apple pies (Thu + Fri, see [[Pie crust]])
- [x] 36 croissants, laminated Wed, baked Sat 06:00 ([[Laminated croissant dough]])
- [x] 4 tortillas, 32 slices ([[Tortilla española]])
- [x] 60 brown butter blondies
- [x] 48 cheese scones
- [x] allergen labels, all 5 products, printed at Ryman
- [x] float: £80 in change, plus the SumUp reader
- [ ] gazebo weights, forgot them, borrowed bricks from the caretaker
- [x] 2 cool boxes, ice packs frozen Fri night

## What sold, and when

- croissants: gone by 11:40, 36 x £3.20
- tortilla: gone by 12:50, 32 x £2.50
- blondies: 60 x £1.50, last one 14:10
- scones: 41 of 48 x £1.80
- pies: whole at £12, 11 of 14 sold. 3 left, cut into slices at £2, 22 slices gone

## Money

- takings: £115.20 + £80 + £90 + £73.80 + £132 + £44 = £535
- ingredient cost £148.60 (receipts in the folder, logged in the [[Budget spreadsheet]] under "community")
- profit to the school: £386.40
- SumUp fees £6.21, I covered them

## Next year

- double the croissants, at least 72
- pies by the slice from the start, nobody wants to carry a whole pie round a fair
- bring gazebo weights
- tortilla was the surprise, do 6
- Tash and her nephew Kyle did the till all day, buy them lunch

Good day. Put it on the [[Gratitude list]].
